title: Sparkly train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rainbow sparkles around the train -->
  <g>
    <!-- star sparkle top-left -->
    <path d='M18 22 L20 27 L25 28 L20 30 L18 35 L16 30 L11 28 L16 27 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
    <!-- sparkle top-right -->
    <path d='M78 18 L80 23 L85 24 L80 26 L78 31 L76 26 L71 24 L76 23 Z' fill='#FF69B4'/>
    <!-- small sparkle left -->
    <path d='M8 55 L9.5 58 L13 59 L9.5 60 L8 63 L6.5 60 L3 59 L6.5 58 Z' fill='#00FFFF'/>
    <!-- small sparkle right -->
    <path d='M90 45 L91.5 48 L95 49 L91.5 50 L90 53 L88.5 50 L85 49 L88.5 48 Z' fill='#FF4500'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
    <path d='M22 82 L24 87 L29 88 L24 90 L22 95 L20 90 L15 88 L20 87 Z' fill='#7CFC00'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
    <path d='M80 78 L82 83 L87 84 L82 86 L80 91 L78 86 L73 84 L78 83 Z' fill='#FFA500'/>
    <!-- tiny sparkles -->
    <circle cx='35' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#FF69B4'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#00FFFF'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='62' r='1.5' fill='#7CFC00'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#FF4500'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  </g>

  <!-- train body -->
  <g>
    <!-- main body -->
    <rect x='22' y='52' width='56' height='26' rx='4' fill='#E63946'/>
    <!-- lighter shade top edge of body -->
    <rect x='22' y='52' width='56' height='5' rx='3' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
    <!-- windows -->
    <rect x='28' y='58' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFFACD'/>
    <rect x='44' y='58' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFFACD'/>
    <!-- cab/engine front -->
    <rect x='64' y='46' width='20' height='32' rx='3' fill='#457B9D'/>
    <!-- cab window -->
    <rect x='68' y='51' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FFFACD'/>
    <!-- cab roof lighter -->
    <rect x='64' y='46' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6FA8C7'/>
    <!-- chimney -->
    <rect x='70' y='36' width='8' height='11' rx='2' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
    <rect x='68' y='34' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
    <!-- smoke puffs -->
    <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='4' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='3' fill='#D0D0D0'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='24' r='3' fill='#C8C8C8'/>
    <!-- base/bumper -->
    <rect x='20' y='78' width='66' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
    <!-- headlight -->
    <circle cx='84' cy='62' r='4' fill='#FFFACD'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='62' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='32' cy='84' r='8' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='84' r='5' fill='#888888'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='84' r='2' fill='#CCCCCC'/>
    <!-- wheel spokes -->
    <line x1='32' y1='77' x2='32' y2='91' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='25' y1='84' x2='39' y2='84' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>

    <circle cx='54' cy='84' r='8' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='84' r='5' fill='#888888'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='84' r='2' fill='#CCCCCC'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='54' y2='91' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='84' x2='61' y2='84' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>

    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='8' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='5' fill='#888888'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='2' fill='#CCCCCC'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='77' x2='74' y2='91' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='67' y1='84' x2='81' y2='84' stroke='#666666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- connecting rod between wheels -->
  <line x1='32' y1='84' x2='74' y2='84' stroke='#AAAAAA' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- track -->
  <rect x='10' y='92' width='80' height='3' rx='1' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <rect x='10' y='95' width='80' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <line x1='10' y1='92.5' x2='90' y2='92.5' stroke='#CD853F' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
